projects.title: SaaS UI lab (source of the SaaS UI pack)
projects.summary: The comps every SaaS UI template and recipe was built and verified in: cursor click, notification toast, toggle switch, KPI tile, sidebar drawer, rolling counter and search typing.

projects.title: SaaS UI lab 2 (source of the round-2 SaaS UI templates)
projects.summary: The 7 comps the round-2 SaaS UI templates were built and verified in: lower third, feature title, CTA end card, modal over an app, chart card, chat thread and dropdown menu.

projects.title: SaaS UI lab 3 (source of the round-3 SaaS UI templates)
projects.summary: The 7 comps the round-3 SaaS UI templates were built and verified in: pricing plans, browser window load, submit to success, kanban drag, integrations hub, zoom to card and review card.

projects.title: SaaS UI showcase (15 s product-UI reel)
projects.summary: A 15.3 s reel cutting the SaaS UI patterns together: search typing, sidebar drawer, KPI tile, a cursor clicking a toggle, a rolling revenue counter and a notification toast.

projects.title: SaaS UI showcase 2 (round-2 templates, 25 s)
projects.summary: A 25 s master that plays every round-2 SaaS UI template back to back, placed from the Library: Feature title, SaaS lower third, Chat thread, Dropdown menu, Modal over app, Chart card, CTA end card.
